news.title: 2nd Test at Hagley Oval starts Fri 27 Nov, 11 am local / 3:30 am IST; series level 0-0 after the Wellington draw, so the winner takes the series
news.note: Preview window closes tonight (IST). Predicted India XI unchanged (Washington the only spinner, Siraj likely out again, Jadeja the alternative).

news.title: NZ without a specialist spinner too: Santner out of the tour (fractured hand); Tickner out, Matt Fisher added as cover
news.note: Both sides may go in with all-seam attacks: a cleaner tactics hook than India's selection alone. Tickner's injury is a hamstring here but a calf strain in yesterday's ETV Bharat report: do not state the injury type.

news.title: Hagley Oval record (as reported): NZ won 9 of 15 Tests; the side bowling first won 9; India lost their only Test there (Feb 2020) inside three days, Jamieson 5/45
